resources.title: Bias Geometry and the Value of Auxiliary Data
resources.rights: All rights reserved according to SSRN. PDF retained privately in the instructor Dropbox folder; public materials contain original commentary, original calculations, and a source link.
resources.focus: Identification of primary response coefficients using a known auxiliary-bias dictionary; optimal sampling cost and bias geometry.
resources.teaching_use: Four-profile product design, sensitivity to omitted bias features, and cost at a common MSE target.
resources.cautions: Linear model, known feature dictionaries, independent Gaussian observations, worst-case coefficient MSE, and high-accuracy cost comparison. Empirical cases are retrospective calibrations with simulated estimation errors.
resources.reading_scope: Main text Sections 1-8; Figures 1-3 and Table 1. Pages 20-21 and 24-25 visually checked. Appendix extracted; proofs not independently verified.
